Note:

For claddings and roofs, the design wind pressure corresponds to the most critical wind
direction (i.e. uphill wind along X-direction) with the application of conatant value over the
lower part of the respective building block.

For canopy, the design wind pressure corresponds to the wind direction towardsthe building
elevation adjacent to the canopy (i.e. downhill wind opposite to X-direction) at canopy level,
with the application of constant value over the lower part of the tower block.

Determination of the design wind pressure for the building elements is given in calculation

sheet A4.
